requirement_text.REQ-116: stage-8-frontend-cutover.md says the contract gaps are "where undocumented behavior the earlier stages' route-by-route port missed will actually surface." Nobody has looked yet. Before any gap can be closed, the gaps have to be enumerated against a running system rather than guessed at by reading route modules. Start Letflow (LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED=1 mix run --no-halt), the Keycloak REQ-128 adds (docker compose up -d), and web/ (npm run dev -- the proxy already defaults to :4000). LOG IN FIRST, then load every route in web/src/router.tsx and record for each one what the SPA requested, what Letflow returned, and what the SPA expected. Logging in is not optional and is why this requirement depends on REQ-128. REQ-071 mounted Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline, so every /api/v1 route now demands a bearer token; without an identity provider an unauthenticated sweep records one identical 401 per route and collapses the NOT-YET-IMPLEMENTED versus SHAPE-MISMATCH distinction this requirement exists to draw. Record the authenticated response for every route; if a route is genuinely unreachable even authenticated, say which and why rather than logging a bare 401. Produce docs/frontend/contract-gaps.md: one row per gap, with the failing request, the expected shape (cited from web/src/types/api.ts or the calling module in web/src/api/), the actual response, and the S4 requirement that owns the route if one exists. This requirement produces an INVENTORY, not fixes. Do not change lib/ and do not change web/src/ to work around anything found -- a gap closed while cataloguing is a gap nobody sized. Many routes will fail simply because S4 is incomplete (REQ-071..085 still pending); "not implemented yet" is a valid and expected row, and distinguishing it from "implemented but shaped wrong" is the substance of this requirement.
